title: Party journeys
summary: Plan a party journey on the map and approve it as downtime; the party marker follows the route as the days pass.
items: Review journey turns a drawn route into a downtime preview: choose the pace, see each day of travel and apply all the days or only some.
Trail rations and mount upkeep are optional costs, off by default, charged once when the DM approves.
While the party is on the road the route is locked, located shops are unavailable, and the marker moves only when downtime is approved.
On arrival the DM confirms Move party here, or Not yet to stay on the road.
Players can send journey requests to the DM, who can approve them in one step from the Review Inbox.
Players see the planned route where the map is visible to them, or a short text card when the map is private.
